GHA.note: Document states nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
Document describes AI training only, no government AI system.
No sectoral AI tool is mentioned.

facts.fact: The Head of the Civil Service and a UNESCO representative refer to Ghana's National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (2025-2035) as the roadmap the government is implementing, with the training aligned to its implementation priorities.

GHA.note: No AI model, dataset or computing is described.

facts.fact: The Government of Ghana, with UNESCO and the EU, launched an AI literacy training programme for 240 Civil Service staff to serve as trainers in their institutions, and the Head of the Civil Service urged HR directors to build AI literacy into onboarding.

systems.owner: Government of Ghana with UNESCO and EU

GHA.note: A training programme says nothing of who runs government systems, so it is other.
